message.content: Verified all seeded defects across the three packages. Reporting findings:

arguments.message: Stored XSS: chat message sender/text (user-controlled, fetched from /api/rooms/:id/messages) are interpolated into an HTML string and assigned directly to innerHTML, so any markup/script in a message executes in the DOM.

arguments.evidence: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: c.html }} />
arguments.message: Stored XSS: comment HTML fetched from the API is rendered unsanitized via dangerouslySetInnerHTML; server/user-supplied markup is injected straight into the page.
Stored XSS: the user profile bio (from /api/users/:id/profile, which itself comes from the DB) is assigned to innerHTML without escaping. Should use textContent.
SQL injection: the route parameter req.params.id is interpolated into the query via a template literal and passed to pool.query with no parameterization or validation.
SQL injection: req.query.name is concatenated into a quoted string literal in the query text. Use a parameterized query: pool.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1", [name]).

Hardcoded signing secret in source: AUTH_SECRET is a literal "sk-..." value used to sign and verify payloads; anyone with repo read access can forge valid signatures. Load from a secret manager/env var and rotate.

arguments.evidence: export const SERVICE_API_KEY = "sk-monorepo-api-7d3f9a2c1e";
arguments.message: Hardcoded API key committed in source: SERVICE_API_KEY is a literal secret exported from the server entry point (and thus also bundled/shipped). Move to environment/secret store and revoke the leaked value.
